metaTitle: Custom Eye Masks with Zipper | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom eye masks with zipper for your team or event. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Eye masks with a zipper offer a practical upgrade over basic slip-on designs. The zippered closure keeps the mask securely in place throughout the night, making them ideal for corporate travel gifts, hotel amenities, or employee wellness kits. Choose from soft cotton or plush fleece materials and add your logo with screen printing or embroidery for a polished, branded look.
heroAltText: Custom eye masks with zipper in black and gray, featuring a secure zippered closure and embroidered logo.
